title: Small Favours
subtitle: One small favour leads to another

quests.title: Just a Loaf
text: Bram the baker would gladly give you a loaf for the road, if he had any flour.

lines: A loaf for the road? There's no flour! It's a catastrophe!
The windmill's stopped. Ask Hesk what's wrong? You're a hero!

quests.title: Torn Sails
text: Miller Hesk is standing under his windmill, looking at it.

lines: Sorry. The storm tore the sails. I can't grind a thing.
New sails need canvas. Canvas means Nell. Would you ask her? Sorry.

quests.title: The Broken Shuttle
text: Nell the weaver would weave canvas this minute, if her loom worked.

lines: Wipe your feet. Canvas? My shuttle snapped at seven past six.
Olsen can carve a new one. And sixteen bundles of straw. Not fifteen.

quests.title: Only the Old Birch Will Do
text: Olsen the carpenter will carve a shuttle. Eventually. He has standards.

lines: A shuttle from ordinary birch? Absolutely not. It'll warp.
Only old birch past the woods, felled with an axe. Eight logs, no stings.

quests.title: Shuttle, Canvas, Sails
text: Now everything can happen in the right order. Take the shuttle to Nell, and the canvas to Hesk.

lines: Exactly right, to the hair. Infuriating. Canvas, folded in eight.
Take it to Hesk.
tasks.title: Bring Nell the shuttle

lines: Canvas? Oh, thank you. Give me an hour.
There. Sails on, mill turning. One bag of flour. Sorry if it isn't enough.
tasks.title: Bring Hesk the canvas

quests.title: The Fox and the Flour
text: On the road back to Reece, something small and orange snatches the flour bag and bolts.

encounter.name: Flour Thief
lines: *The fox drops the flour bag, eyeing your berries.*
*It takes the berries and trots off, very pleased with itself.*
Real flour! I'm crying. You're a legend! Three loaves and a breadbox.
Next favour, you have my permission to run.

quests.title: The Ferryman's Fee
text: Gil the ferryman will row anyone across to the island village, for a fee.

lines: I'll row you, for a good fishing net. Mine's more hole than net.
Ada, next village along the lake, makes the best. Tell her Gil sent you.

quests.title: Out of Rope
text: Ada can knot a net blindfolded. She's out of rope.

lines: Gil owes me for the last net. I'm out of rope, though.
Rope means flax. Farmer Tamsin, round the lake. Mind the beans.
tasks.title: Ask Ada about the net

quests.title: The Scarecrow's Hat
text: Farmer Tamsin won't spare a stalk until her scarecrow has its hat back.

lines: Flax? Not a stalk, not till he has his hat.
A witch's cat took it into the swamp. Go and get it.

quests.title: A Witch's Bargain
text: The witch will give the hat back, for a pot of proper black tea brewed in a copper kettle. She's very particular about the kettle.

lines: Tea in a copper kettle. You know the old ways. Take the hat.
Now go away before I put the kettle back on.
tasks.title: Trade the tea to the witch

rewards.name: The Scarecrow's Hat
lore: A faded hat, slightly chewed by a cat.

quests.title: Hat, Flax, Rope
text: Return the hat to its scarecrow, and Tamsin gives you a sheaf of flax. Twist it into rope and take it to Ada, who knots the net while you wait.

lines: His hat! Chewed, but his. Look at him glow.
Take a sheaf of flax. Tell Ada the rope's on me.
tasks.title: Return the hat to Tamsin

lines: Good, strong rope. Sit. Don't touch the mesh.
There, knotted while you waited. Tell Gil it's the last on credit.
tasks.title: Take the rope to Ada

quests.title: The Crossing
text: Gil takes the net, keeps his word and rows you out to the island village. Halfway across, the drowned come up around the boat.

lines: Ada's net! She's forgiven me, I think. Hop in, mind the wet bit.
The lake's gone quiet. It's never quiet.

encounter.name: Drowned
lines: *A drowned lurches up beside the boat.*

encounter.name: Drowned
lines: *Another drowned climbs out of the water.*

quests.title: Paperwork
text: The piglin camp's gatekeeper won't let a stranger barter without a permit, stamped by the chief's clerk. The clerk is in the big tent. Probably.

lines: No permit, no barter. See the clerk.
Big tent. Probably.
tasks.title: Ask the gatekeeper how to trade

quests.title: The Ink Has Dried
text: The clerk can't write a permit: his ink has dried in the heat. The chief's permits are always written in glow ink, from glow squid in the Overworld.

tasks.title: Bring glow ink from the Overworld's glow squid

lines: Glow ink? Finally. The chief demands it.
The stamp is cracked, though.
tasks.title: Give the clerk the glow ink

quests.title: The Cracked Stamp
text: The clerk's stamp is cracked. A brute at the camp's forge will cast a new one from a gold block, if you survive his arm-wrestling swings for a minute.

tasks.title: Bring a gold block for the new stamp

lines: The brute wants a wrestle. Stand your ground.

tasks.title: Survive the brute's swings for a minute

quests.title: Signed by the Chief
text: Stamped, but not signed. The chief is asleep, and waking him badly is how outsiders get eaten. Piglins dance to a drum. Play one by his bed until he wakes in a good mood.

tasks.title: Make a drum to wake the chief gently

encounter.name: The Sleeping Chief
lines: *The chief stirs, stamps a foot, and signs with a grunt.*

tasks.title: Wake the chief with a drum by his bed

quests.title: Permit Granted
text: Hand the signed, stamped permit to the gatekeeper. He reads it twice, upside down, and lets you in to trade.

tasks.title: Carry the signed, stamped permit to the gate

lines: Signed. Stamped. Upside down is fine. Welcome.
tasks.title: Hand the permit to the gatekeeper
